content:
This dialogue is from the movie **"The Social Network"**.

Specifically, it's part of the scene where Mark Zuckerberg is talking with his friend Eduardo Saverin about the early, rapid growth of Facebook. They are discussing how Zuckerberg managed to get so many people to submit their personal information (emails, pictures, addresses, etc.) to the platform.
